result.summary: Simplifies the macOS codesign verification check used in CI. This is a small cleanup following up on previous changes to codesigning flags.
result.problem: Following changes in PR #34914 that updated codesign invocation flags, the CI checks retained extra complexity or redundant commands identified during code review.
evidence: Followup to #34914 addressing a specific review comment on macOS codesigning check logic (PR description)
result.card: Simplifies the macOS codesign check in CI as a followup to PR #34914. It addresses minor cleanup and simplification suggestions raised during review of the earlier PR. The change touches only test/CI scripts and carries minimal operational risk.
uncertainties: Exact diff and file list were unavailable, but scope is limited to +3/-5 in 2 CI files
